verdict.rationale: mParticle documents APIs for querying/creating audiences (Platform Audiences API, Composable Audiences, Warehouse Sync API, real-time personalization API) that could in principle be called by an agent, but connecting an audience to an activation output is documented as a dashboard/UI step ('Navigate to Data Platform > Setup > Directory, and click the card') rather than a pure API call, and there is no mention of an MCP server or agent-native interface. Missing for 10: documented MCP server or agent tool, API-only audience activation without console steps, and any hands-on evidence of an agent completing the full query→create→activate loop.
